question: Which of the following is NOT a microblogging site?
solution:
The correct answer is **Pinterest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pinterest** is primarily a visual discovery engine for finding ideas like recipes, home and style inspiration, and more.
 
• Unlike microblogging sites, Pinterest focuses on sharing images and visual content rather than text updates.
 
• Users create and share collections of visual bookmarks (called "pins") organized into themed boards.
